_comment: Clients whose revenue is NOT collected through a payment gateway, and so has
to be derived from the leads delivered instead.
Each rule matches campaigns by a pattern on their name, groups them into their
own category, and values every lead at `perLead`. The gross/commission/credits
figures are recorded so the report can show HOW the rate was arrived at — they
are not recalculated, so if the deal changes, change perLead too.
A rule replaces any gateway revenue for those campaigns. If the gateway DOES
hold payments for them, the report says so rather than quietly discarding them.

rules.footnote: is not based on actual receipts but rather based on accrued revenue of $48 per lead calculated as follows: Leads are sold at $75 each, less $15 per lead for Cooper's commission leaving $60 net. Credit allowance is 20% of leads resulting in a realised price of $48 per lead (80% of $60).
